checks.name: Exact analyzer accepts known non-periodic correct cursor/pitch without an ACK-only position pass
Correct pitch and plausible ACK cannot hide a wrong original cursor
Wrong/raw pitch and40ms silence retain strict30ms/20ms failures
Silent/flat or periodic10Hz marker cannot manufacture a unique source cursor
Direct end-position-at+40ms ACK exposes its43.2ms original-time lag against ideal clock
Exact producer preserves full stereo PCM/preflight64/fences and zeros every physical output
Actual WASM steady control reports cursor correlation accuracy rather than trusting scheduled position
